web.named_query: ("Olivia Trusty" OR "Hunter Deely") AI artificial intelligence superintelligence policy statements

summary.text: On May 7, 2026, Trusty described drones and AI as foundational to America's economic and national security. On February 9, 2026, she linked spectrum, infrastructure, and predictable policy to U.S. leadership in the AI era and extending its benefits to every community. In an undated statement, she said she remained open-minded about the FCC's authority and the policy merits of AI reporting and disclosure requirements, pending review of the record.
